explain.notes: Vowel harmony: a word's vowels are either all back (a, u) or all front (e, i), and suffix vowels follow the stem. Checked against 189 alternative analyses; the sentences rule out 184, including: -tu/-ti appears when: animate; -tu/-ti appears when: plural & animate.
